fonts.display: 'FlatfileDiatypeVariable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Flatfile Diatype (Variable)', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Midnight Ink
palette.role: Primary brand color for headings, logo, emphasized text, nav labels, and icon strokes — a near-black with a faint violet cast that reads as ink rather than pure black against the cream canvas

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Dark elevated surface for cards, headers, and contained panels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Primary body and heading text, dark card fills, and icon fills — the workhorse near-black with the faintest cool cast

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Secondary dark surfaces and muted borders for inverted panels

palette.name: Steel
palette.role: Mid-gray for supporting UI marks, icon fills, and medium borders

palette.name: Silver
palette.role: Lighter mid-gray for tertiary text, placeholder copy, and decorative fills

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Subtle border tone for ghost controls and quiet dividers

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: The system's structural hairline — dominant border, divider, and table-rule color across every layout context

palette.name: Parchment
palette.role: Warm sage-cream wash used as the hero background and as the secondary button fill — gives the page its printed-paper atmosphere

palette.name: Linen
palette.role: Card and elevated surface background — one step off the page to create depth without shadows

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Pure white reserved for inverted buttons, tag chips, and high-contrast list items where Mist would be too muted

palette.name: Slate Link
palette.role: Default link and breadcrumb text color, distinct from body text gray
